# EnterpriseGlue v0.21.0 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.20.9`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains compatibility changes that require the upgrade guidance below.

## Highlights

- **identity:** Block pooled email-only account adoption and preserve exact browser-session identity and provider logout lineage through tenant switching.
- **tenancy:** Add durable signed release-activation operation receipts so an exact retry cannot repeat a committed activation.

## User and administrator impact

- Pooled providers cannot adopt an existing shared account by email. Tenant switching requires matching current access and refresh credentials. Invitations cannot initialize a password on an established shared account.
- Fresh pooled invitees can enroll through their organization's OIDC, SAML or LDAP provider. Password setup is available only when tenant policy permits it.
- Canonical tenant pages load installed plugin entries through tenant-prefixed URLs. Unprefixed pooled pages no longer send an invented default-tenant hint during requests or refresh, and failed refreshes return to the current hostname's login route.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Review historical provider links and coordinate host/shared-package upgrades. Pooled legacy access/refresh credentials are rejected; arrange an authorized upgrade and reauthentication window, including recovery administrators.
- Existing release-assignment v1/v2 clients remain unchanged.

## API and integration compatibility

- POST /api/auth/switch-tenant requires the refresh cookie to match the exact session of the access principal. Legacy and bearer-only switch calls require a new sign-in.
- Invitation acknowledgments support pooled enrollmentMode and policy-dependent requiresPasswordSet. Dedicated onboarding login-method discovery and provider start/login routes require the verified onboarding cookie. Tenant-prefixed invitation and onboarding endpoints enforce invitation/path binding and preserve verified placement context; root compatibility endpoints remain.
- GET/HEAD /t/:tenantSlug/_enterpriseglue/plugins/:pluginId/:version/*assetPath serves the same public, digest-verified installed entry bytes as the legacy root route, with no-store caching. Bootstrap entry URL integrity validation is unchanged. Proxies/CDN routing examples must send this alias to the backend, not the SPA.
- Add a controller-only release-assignment-operations endpoint with mandatory placement and immutable idempotency binding.

## Configuration

- The provider-level allowVerifiedEmailLinking option must not authorize cross-tenant account linking in pooled mode.
- Uses existing pooled-tenancy release-controller authorization and workload receipt signing configuration.

## Database migrations

- Uses the existing refresh-token primary key and user revocation version; no schema change. Physical PostgreSQL race checks do not certify all supported database engines.
- Reuses the existing text-command lifecycle operation ledger; retain completed activation records to fence late duplicates.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Matching provider email and existing tenant membership are not independent proof of control of a shared user account.
- Historical receipts certify one committed activation, not current tenant state, plugin quiescence, or worker termination.

## Known limitations

- Combined qualification remains required before release. Package versions are prepared locally; no publication or deployed upgrade is implied.
- Single-tenant legacy refreshes retain ID-less access-token compatibility until expiry or explicit revocation. Fresh-invited OIDC/SAML/LDAP browser journeys pass against local emulators; public-edge and customer identity-provider qualification remain pending. Independent account-control enrollment and historical-link disposition remain outstanding.
- Plugin assets use the current tenant release assignment, not an immutable page release pin. Only the manifest-declared frontend entry is served; general code-split chunks are not newly supported.
- Cloud recovery integration remains pending; a historical activation receipt does not prove current worker or plugin quiescence.

## Rollback

- Do not roll back a qualified identity-isolation fix without reviewing the restored account-linking exposure.
- Disable the new consumer before reverting the host; preserve operation records and receipt verification keys.

## Validation evidence

- Targeted service, route, middleware, UI, physical PostgreSQL race tests and the integrated OIDC/SAML/LDAP browser-emulator journey pass locally. The existing five-adapter database matrix passes locally with dirty-development evidence, including the Spanner emulator; this is not clean release certification or proof of session races on every adapter. Combined qualification and protected exact-revision CI remain pending.
- Focused schema, route, service, authorization and OpenAPI tests pass.
- The physical PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle and Spanner qualification matrix passes locally; protected exact-commit qualification remains CI evidence.
